title: New Hoffman–Levin collaboration on recursive trace logic

tellings.quote: Actually we're just now starting up a collaboration. we're going to get a postto together because of the trace logic um this recursive trace logic

plain: Donald Hoffman, a scientist who studies perception and consciousness, says he and a scientist named Mike Levin are 'just now starting up a collaboration' in 2026. He tells Michels they plan to hire a postdoctoral researcher to work on what he calls 'recursive trace logic,' a piece of mathematics he does not explain further.
